name: zreader_try_resolve_path
description: zReader::TryResolvePath resolves a filename directly, through a temporary extra search path, or through the global zReader search path list.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; Binary Ninja still carries a documented repne scasb/strlen rendering limitation, so final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zReader path-resolution source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cd40 validates direct FileExists success returning the filename, non-empty extraSearchPath creating a temporary search-path list, resolving through zUtil_ZRDR_ResolvePathInSearchPathList, freeing that temporary list, and falling back to g_zRdr_SearchPathList when unresolved.

The native zReader resolve/open smoke verifies direct existing-file return, temporary extra search-path resolution, global search-path fallback when extraSearchPath is empty, and shared resolved-path behavior used by zUtil_ZRDR_OpenFileResolved.
owner_data_evidence: Source owner candidate: zReader namespace path-resolution code is recovered as typed namespace functions using zArchiveList search-path records and CRT path providers, with no source-shape scaffolds.

Data gate candidate: 0x48cd40 reads g_zRdr_SearchPathList at 0x56b180 and delegates shared resolved-path buffers to the accepted zReader/ZRDR data closure; the function writes no private authored data.
